articles.title: A Diesel Export Threat Puts Fuel Reserves in the Spotlight
articles.summary: Keeping fuel at home could lower prices in one place and raise them elsewhere. The United States exports up to 1.5 million barrels of diesel a day, making its next decision important to other countries.

articles.title: Campaign Claims: What the Numbers Measure Matters
articles.summary: An investment pledge is not the same as money already spent. PolitiFact’s review of Trump’s campaign statements compares headline figures with records, time periods and important qualifications.

articles.title: Two Lawsuits Seek Accountability in Renee Good’s Death
articles.summary: A legal filing sets out claims; it does not settle them. Renee Good’s family has brought two cases over her January death in Minneapolis, requesting different types of trials.
